description: framegate.py places a snapshot only by the trace: the frame holding the checkpoint's clock call and the clock-call sites since that frame's head (classify()). At HEAD 4bfefc2a the port exposes no ordering between its drawing calls, its Terrain passes and a gfx snapshot: gfx.log gives counts and the distinct unsupported reasons as a set, the LiveTerrain log has no clock position, and tick's SG_TICK_TRACE (every TkBase call) costs about 17,000 lines per in-game frame (sandbox_basic 150 MB, 49 s against 7.5 s), too much for the census.
path to resolution: Merge 2_merge.md items 1-2 (gfx.cpp writes its first-occurrence list and a per-snapshot terrain flag into gfx.log); framegate.py reads them when present (columns unsup_order = gfx, terrain_rule + snapshot_terrain).

description: The terrain rule calls every checkpoint of an in-game frame `yes` unless the context names a full-screen modal (showCreditsScreen) or the frame left for the title menu. Five MODAL:waitTicks checkpoints are full-screen screens whose clock reads are waitTicks' only (cov_a_career career_editor, cov_a_golfer button_0, cov_a_keys3 q_editor, cov_a_keys k_worldmap, cov_k1_routing routing: reference frames viewed); the trace cannot tell them from popups over the course view (16 others viewed). They read terrain yes.
path to resolution: The gfx snapshot_terrain flag of 2_merge.md item 2 (a full-screen 2D write after the frame's terrain pass clears it) decides them from the run.

description: Screen kinds of the boot frame come from the waitTicks period of the loop the checkpoint sits in: waitTicks(1, 0) = the title menu (tick_menu.inc ML+0x11a69), 5 ticks or a last read in pumpAndRedraw with courseActionMenu.setup drawn = the location screen (courseActionMenu; the 5-tick wait is measured on cov_b_location and cov_l_point, the port's courseActionMenu drops its waits). Another boot screen waiting 1 or 5 ticks per pass would get the title or location regions; none of the 39 boot checkpoints of the 61 traced scenarios does (2_context_census.tsv), so this is not observed.
path to resolution: Name the screen from the run (gfx notes which screen body drew last) when the backend draws more boot screens.

description: unsup_order: without the gfx first-occurrence list the order of the unsupported reasons comes from the probe run's TkBase trace (first call of the reason's function, SG_TICK_CALL_LIMIT 3,000,000 = about 175 in-game frames). A body's own reason (`Surface_stretchBlit: a SpriteRef the backend has no sprite for`) occurs at or after its function's first call, drops that modules hand to gfx_drop directly (saveload.cpp gx) are never traced, and reasons first seen after the limit are unordered; such rows read `partial` (course_season sandbox .. season_120) or `final` when every reason of the run came before the snapshot.

gfx.render (port/test/gfx.py) runs the boot through (frames up to the last checkpoint) + 1 records. A checkpoint in a frame's H1 wait is snapshotted at the next cursor read or dispatch past it, which lies in the following frame's body, so a last checkpoint in an H1 wait gets no snapshot (course_season hole_open alone: NOT_RUN). framegate.py runs one frame further and to the end of the trace when that passes the last FRAME record (cov_r_quit's title and credits checkpoints).
path to resolution: 2_merge.md item 4 (same fix in gfx.render); test_gfx's checkpoints are not affected (menu and cov_b_location are in the boot frame).

description: re/analysis/data/scenario_refs.json lists 609 checkpoints in its 64 scenarios (the summaries agree), not 649 as the S0.2 / S0.3 rows say; 34 of them (cov_a_quit 15, cov_a_quit_title 9, golfer_events 10) have no trace in port/corpus/traces and read NOT_RUN MISSING.
path to resolution: The lead corrects the count in the S0.3 row; traces for the three scenarios are a phase 2.4 matter (U-0681 for golfer_events).
